responsibility: Implements the XCOFF-specific half of GCC’s stabs-style debug output, complementing dbxout.c with AIX/XCOFF line-number, block, file, and function directives. This file manages .bf/.ef/.bb/.eb and .line emission, include-file state and relative-versus-absolute line numbering within functions, XCOFF fundamental type-number assignment, XCOFF function declaration pseudo-ops such as .function, and the block traversal used to output symbols in the form expected by the XCOFF assembler and debugger environment.
same_name_distinction: Implements the XCOFF-specific stabs-side emission behavior—such as .bf/.ef/.bb/.eb, .line handling, include-file state, function pseudo-ops, and XCOFF type-number assignment—that complements dbxout.c. Unlike xcoffout.h, it is the active backend code rather than the macro/policy and prototype layer consumed by dbxout.c and targets.
